conventions.convention: Category descriptors always carry intent. Root Unleash may omit customCategory.
Category eligibility must not be stricter than its children.
Child actions map every Papyrus parameter; empty static when Papyrus detects at runtime.
In-game SKSE must be Release. Debug /MDd breaks SkyrimNet decorator ABI. CRT stays /MD (x64-windows-static-md).
ESP source of truth is Spriggit/SkyrimNet_Leashed/, not a hand-edited .esp.
Do not vendor or recompile LeashFramework.psc; call the runtime natives.
Wrists is chain only. Distance picks Leash_hand_chain 0xD69 (tight/short), 0x1 long (middle), 0x3 xlong (long). KindForBodyPart and PrismaUI lockWristType force type to chain.
Dependency update reviews use skill dependency_drift and checkpoints/<dependency-name>-<version>.md. LF pin: checkpoints/leashframework-1.1.3.md. SkyrimNet pin: checkpoints/skyrimnet-beta25-rc7.md.

Beta 25 LLM content ships as SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/external/goodprovider.leashed/. Action YAML filename equals in-file name. Settings schema stays at config/plugins/SkyrimNet_Leashed/. Do not ship into library/.
